# Mitishell v1.1.0

## Changes

- The shell font is now configurable. Settings > System lists every installed Nerd Font family, previews each entry in its own family, and applies the choice live across the bar, popovers, Settings, and the OSD. Only Nerd Font families are offered because the shell's icons are Nerd Font glyphs; an unpatched family would leave the bar without icons. The choice persists as `font.family` and accepts the same validation through `mitishell config set`.
- Bar widgets that open a popover or menu now share one selected look: while open, the widget fills with its accent at a low alpha and gains a matching accent border. The control-center rail uses the same accent treatment for the active page, so the border and fill always match, and keyboard focus keeps its own blue ring instead of appearing on click.
- Update checks run when the shell starts and daily at 09:00 local time. A failed check retries gently until it succeeds instead of rechecking every few minutes all day.
- An off night light no longer reports its temperature in Quick Settings or the on-screen display.

## Requirements

> [!NOTE]  
> Optional features degrade safely when their tools are absent. Weather is disabled by default because it uses wttr.in. Automatic location allows the service to infer a rough location from the request. Manual location sends the configured place text instead.

- Arch Linux
- Hyprland
- hyprshutdown
- QuickShell 0.3.0
- A Nerd Font for shell and OSD glyphs. Choosing a different font in Settings requires at least one installed Nerd Font family.
- NetworkManager for networking
- BlueZ for Bluetooth
- A working user systemd session for reminders
- `ddcutil` and i2c access for monitor brightness

## Install a Prebuilt Release

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.1.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.1.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.1.0-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```

## Install From Source

Source builds need Go 1.26 or newer, Qt 6 QML tooling, Node.js, and GNU Make.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aileks/mitishell.git
cd mitishell
git checkout v1.1.0
make check
make install
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
